title: Standard of Care training workshop for drinking water
subtitle: No motions were recorded; the committee held a Walkerton Clean Water Centre workshop on Safe Drinking Water Act responsibilities.
overview: The Committee of the Whole met on March 1, 2023 and spent the meeting on a training workshop rather than on business items. The minutes record no motions and no recommendations to Council.

A facilitator from the Walkerton Clean Water Centre explained the responsibilities that come with the Statutory Standard of Care under the Safe Drinking Water Act. The course aimed to help participants recognize the three key responsibilities, identify the key questions to ask to fulfill them, and discuss lessons learned from case studies.

The workshop followed the course workbook through four modules: Recognizing Your Duty, Staying Informed, Exercising Vigilance, and Case Studies. For residents, the session matters because members of Council hold a legal duty of care in overseeing the municipal drinking water system. The meeting adjourned at 12:23 pm. No pecuniary interests were disclosed in the minutes' record of item 3.
